pr_title: feat: agent roleUniversalIdentifier for manifest-driven role assignment

comments.body: The UUID check is skipped for an empty string. With `roleUniversalIdentifier: ''`, `isNonEmptyString('')` is false, so `defineAgent` reports success and adds no error. The server then treats it as set: `compute-application-manifest-all-universal-flat-entity-maps.service.ts:370` uses `isDefined(agentManifest.roleUniversalIdentifier)`, which is true for `''`. It builds a roleTarget with `roleUniversalIdentifier: ''`, and the sync fails later with an unhelpful "Role not found" validation error. Validate with `isDefined(...)` so `''` is rejected locally, or have the server check `isNonEmptyString` as well.
